company.name: Sentinel Defence Logistics Ltd
company.description: Bristol-headquartered managed-logistics provider delivering integrated defence supply-chain, controlled-stores distribution and vehicle availability services to the Ministry of Defence (MOD), Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S) and prime contractors across the United Kingdom. The operation runs a main Defence Fulfilment Centre at Avonmouth, Bristol, with forward distribution nodes near Sheffield, Manchester and Leeds and a Northern hub close to Glasgow. Activity spans serialised asset and Class V munitions chain-of-custody movements, condition-based (CBM) line-replaceable-unit (LRU) returns, ration and combat-supply (Class I) replenishment, fuel and lubricant (Class III) bulk movement, and cross-echelon redistribution between depots, garrisons and forward operating bases under the Whole Fleet Management (WFM) concept. Every prime mover carries AVL/GPS for in-transit visibility (ITV), OBD2 engine telematics and a utility-box telemetry unit monitoring container seal/tamper state, temperature and humidity for sensitive electronics and propellant, shock/tilt for munitions, and door status. The fleet operates under a DVSA-regulated standard international O-licence with EU/GB tachograph and drivers' hours compliance, DVLA registration, DVSA MOT/annual test, and ADR / Carriage of Dangerous Goods Regulations 2009 for the movement of Class 1 explosives (with Explosives Regulations 2014 and MOD JSP 482 controls), Class 3 fuels and Class 8 corrosives. Movements are classification-aware: consignments carry protective markings (OFFICIAL, OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE, SECRET) and the in-cab terminal supports offline/EMCON operation where signature emission must be minimised. Mission readiness, availability KPIs, seal integrity and serialised inventory reconciliation against the consignment manifest are tracked end-to-end.

Generated for the FleetFlow/Armada v2 schema. Free text in English; JSON keys in English. Reflects in-transit visibility (ITV) and asset availability, serialised asset/munitions chain-of-custody with NSN/UIN and consignment tracking, classification-aware (OFFICIAL / OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE / SECRET) offline/EMCON tracking, condition-based maintenance (CBM) sensor data on line-replaceable units, seal/tamper integrity, and cross-echelon (depot-garrison-FOB) visibility. Verified 2026-06-26 against DVSA standard international O-licence and MOT/annual test, EU/GB tachograph and drivers' hours, DVLA registration, ADR / Carriage of Dangerous Goods Regulations 2009, Explosives Regulations 2014 and MOD JSP 482 explosives storage & transport, JSP 440 security of defence assets, and the Whole Fleet Management (WFM) availability construct.

notes.body: SECRET consignment handled per JSP 440. EMCON requested for the final leg to Liverpool to minimise emission signature; in-cab terminal switched to offline store-and-forward at 09:30. Custody form double-signed by sending and receiving custodians.

notes.body: SDL-33 declared VOR following nearside hub bearing failure detected by CBM vibration trend. Replacement hub bearing LRU on back-order; estimated return to service 2026-06-27. Core pool availability reduced by one until repaired.

notes.author: CBM Analyst
notes.body: Six powerpack control LRUs returned against CBM vibration thresholds exceeding the 4.5 mm/s RMS alert band. Condition recorder data exported and handed to BAE for bench diagnosis. Overhauled units to return under WO-1008.

notes.author: Abnormal Loads Officer
notes.body: STGO Category 3 movement of Warrior hull running to movement order SMO-2026-0455. Police forces notified along route. Lashing re-check at Sheffield confirmed load secure; convoy holding for off-peak window before final urban approach to Catterick.

notes.author: Cold Chain Coordinator
notes.body: Medical cold-chain run delivered with zero temperature excursions, holding between 4.6C and 5.2C throughout. Continuous trace printed at Catterick medical centre and counter-signed. Logger battery health nominal.

notes.author: Fuels Controller
notes.body: F-54 issue completed. Dip and meter reconciliation at Catterick showed -20 L against loaded quantity, within temperature-compensation tolerance. ADR documentation and tremcards complete; orange plates removed after discharge.

notes.author: Compliance Officer
notes.body: Driver CPC card expires 2026-11-01. Periodic training to be booked before driver returns from annual leave to avoid lapse. ADR tank endorsement also approaching renewal (2027-01-31) - flag at next review.

notes.author: Driver DRV-01
notes.body: Pre-task walk-round (first-use check) completed at Avonmouth. ADR equipment, tremcards and PPE present. Bolt-seal reader paired with utility box and reporting. No defects.

notes.author: Account Manager
notes.body: Joint Munitions Command confirmed tasking profile for the week including UN0012, UN0181 and UN0323 consignments. All movements to carry escort and bolt-seal regime; SECRET-marked items to follow JSP 440 handling and EMCON where directed.

notes.author: Asset Custodian
notes.body: 40 serialised gun barrel assemblies received into Avonmouth secure store bay 3 and booked into the asset register. All serials reconciled against manifest MF-0120 with nil discrepancy; chain-of-custody closed.

notes.author: Tanker Driver DRV-05
notes.body: Tanker meter calibration certificate in date (cal 2026-05-02). Bottom-loading and vapour recovery functioning normally. Daily ADR checklist completed with nil leak findings at Sheffield halt.

notes.author: Convoy Commander
notes.body: Armed escort vehicle SDL-02 in lead. Convoy speed limited to 80 km/h. Final leg to Liverpool under EMCON; positions buffered for upload on arrival at the strategic mounting point.
